VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The reviewer note raises a credible concern about tax-inclusive invoices still experiencing rounding drift due to per-line tax rounding before subtotal summation. While the agent claims all 71 tests pass locally, this is a self-report without CI verification. The reviewer's observation—though informal and unverified by them—identifies a potential gap in the fix that directly contradicts satisfaction of the acceptance criteria ("Invoice rounding is correct to the cent"). The agent's solution appears incomplete for the full scope of multi-line invoice scenarios.
